excerpt_i18n.en: On July 17, at the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC), Alipay and JieYue reached a system-level AI Agent cooperation. The two sides collaborated deeply around JieYue’s STEP-X native AI terminal, allowing users to call Alipay’s AI version “Abao” via natural language to access real-world services, enabling cross-app and multi-task execution, and ushering intelligent agents into a new phase of “cross-terminal interconnected task handling.” In this cooperation, STEP-X handles user intent understanding and system scheduling, while Abao relies on Alipay’s ecosystem network to connect services such as transportation, local life, and payment. Both sides use Alipay’s self-developed heterogeneous agent cross-terminal interconnection solution AHA (Agent Hub-Access) to coordinate tasks, achieving a complete closed loop from intent understanding and task execution to service delivery.
